svg.title: Canary releases
svg.desc: A load balancer sends 5 percent of chat traffic to a canary running the new version and the rest to the stable version. A metrics panel compares errors, p99 latency and delivery rate for both. They match, so the canary is promoted to 25, 50 and finally 100 percent of traffic.
svg.text: The canary gets 5% of traffic, matches the baseline, and grows to 100%.
